title: Docker Container Discipline
description: Container creation pitfalls — privileged mode, latest tags, missing resource limits.

rules.message: Privileged container = host root. Multi-tenant violation, complete escape path.
rules.remediation: Use specific capabilities via CapAdd instead; e.g. ['NET_ADMIN'].
Pin a specific digest or semver tag. Update via controlled bump.

rules.message: Image reference without tag — defaults to :latest, same problem as above.
Bind mount to host root / docker.sock — full host compromise.
rules.remediation: Mount only the per-server volume path under ProgramData/volumes/<serverId>.

rules.message: createContainer call may be missing Memory limit — single tenant can starve host.
rules.remediation: Always set HostConfig.Memory and NanoCpus per ServerCreateConfig contract.
